name: Portugal

items.label: Taxable income (rendimento coletável)
items.note: Pay less the specific deduction: €4,587.09 (8.54 × the 2026 social support index), or social security paid if more.

items.label: Tax at IRS rates
items.note: Married couples filing jointly apply the rates to half their joint income and double the result.

items.label: Income tax (IRS)
items.note: 2026 rates after the October 2026 cut (backdated to January) to the first six bands. Tax may not leave less than the €12,880 subsistence minimum.

items.label: Additional solidarity rate
items.note: 2.5% of taxable income between €80,000 and €250,000, 5% above.

assumptions: Mainland Portugal (the Azores and Madeira have lower rates)
Employment (Category A) income only; the annual gross includes the 13th and 14th month payments
notModelled: IRS Jovem (partial exemption for workers under 35)
Personal deductions (general family expenses, health, education, housing)
The Azores and Madeira regional rates
provisional: Monthly withholding in 2026 used the earlier rates; the annual return settles the difference

sources.title: Código do IRS, art. 68.º (taxas) and art. 25.º (dedução específica)
Jornal de Negócios — Redução intercalar das taxas do IRS em 2026 aprovada no Parlamento (9 Oct 2026)

obtainedFrom.title: Web search, 24 Oct 2026
obtainedFrom.note: 2026 thresholds (especialistadoirs, idealista, Cofidis agree); rate cut approved 9 Oct 2026 with effect from 1 Jan 2026 (Contas Poupança, Jornal de Negócios, ECO, HR Portugal agree); specific deduction €4,587.09 and subsistence minimum €12,880 (fedfinance quoting the AT).

tests.note: Social security 1,650 is less than €4,587.09, so the fixed deduction applies: taxable 10,412.91. Tax 1,017.72 + 2,070.91 × 15.2% = 314.78 → 1,332.50.
